name: Azure Boards
description: Your Azure Boards work items (Azure DevOps Services) in Orca: what is assigned to you and your teams' boards. Search, move items between states and columns, and start work on one with a coding agent.

cover.alt: Azure Boards for Orca: the team board and the Start work form in Orca's sidebar

screenshots.alt: Assigned to me: work items grouped by state, with type icons, task progress and pull requests
Board: the team's current sprint in its own columns, with WIP limits and Doing/Done halves
Item actions: open in the browser, Start work and Move to
Start work: sending a ready prompt about the work item to an open coding agent
Search: filtering the items by part of the title
Settings: connection, projects, board, display and refresh sections

settings.title: Organization
settings.description: The name in https://dev.azure.com/<organization>. You can paste the URL instead.

settings.title: Group work items by
settings.description: How the panel groups the list. You can also change it from the panel.

settings.title: Remove the area prefix from titles
settings.description: Hides a leading [Team or area name] in titles when it matches the item's area path.

settings.title: Hide completed items
settings.description: Leaves out items in a completed state, such as Closed or Done: only from an item's child list, or from every list.

settings.title: Hide the Assigned to me tab
settings.description: Shows only the boards you added. You can also change it in the panel's settings.

settings.title: Refresh every
settings.description: Reloads the list while the panel is visible. Off reloads only when you press Refresh.

settings.title: Hidden states
settings.description: Comma-separated work item states left out of the list.
